cases.name: Jacqueline Nuñez-Millan
cases.about: Her obituary said, "Jacky was a sophomore at Piute High School who loved to play sports. She was an athlete, participated in volleyball, basketball, softball, cross country running, track and field. She was a ray of sunshine in everyone’s life. She would love to be remembered as a light-hearted, funny, caring, kind, smart, brave, strong young lady."
cases.narrative: He allegedly shot her in the leg as she was fleeing from his vehicle for an unknown reason, shattering her femur, then fired multiple rounds at a vehicle being driven by her friend as she was attempting to reach it, shattering the passenger side window. Nunez' friend reportedly had to drive away for safety reasons after being shot at multiple times and Aguilar walked over to where Nunez was lying on the ground and shot her in the head, killing her.
